fields.response: raw: empty day (no data, no output)
fields.response.hrvReadings[].readingTimeGMT: raw: timestamp that sets the row time
fields.response.hrvReadings[].readingTimeLocal: raw: local time that sets the zone offset
fields.response.hrvSummary.baseline.markerValue: raw: gauge position of the status display (UI)
fields.response.sleepEndTimestampGMT: raw: sleep window (stored in sleep_sessions by garmin.sleep)
fields.response.sleepStartTimestampGMT: raw: sleep window (stored in sleep_sessions by garmin.sleep)
fields.response.startTimestampGMT: raw: timestamp that sets the zone offset with the local start
fields.response.startTimestampLocal: raw: local time that sets the zone offset
